testcase.name: Scenario: Keep Text Off appearance when switching ribbon tabs: target/native-scratch.HSqCy5/current-ribbon-appearance-source/features/application/ribbon-appearance/ribbon-appearance.feature:160:3
testcase.system-out: Scenario: Keep Text Off appearance when switching ribbon tabs ✔ Given `fixtures/cad/workspace-layout-native.opd` is open and active with the full Tools ribbon visible in the MCAD Software ✔ And the ribbon appearance is Normal ✔ When the user right-clicks the Tools Options panel title ✔ And the user opens Ribbon Appearance ✔ And the user selects Text Off ✔ Then the Tools command icons are visible without their command labels ✔ And the Tools panel titles remain visible ✔ When the user selects the 3D Model ribbon tab ✔ Then the 3D Model command icons are visible without their command labels ✔ And the 3D Model panel titles remain visible ✔ When the user right-clicks the Modify panel title ✔ And the user opens Ribbon Appearance ✔ Then Text Off is marked as selected ✔ When the user selects Normal ✔ Then command labels are visible on the 3D Model ribbon ✔ When the user selects the Tools ribbon tab ✔ Then the full Tools ribbon and its command labels are visible
